propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate was an associate-grade Quantitative Analyst in a retail bank's model validation function for three years, working as second reviewer on eleven credit risk model validations under the reviewer of record, after one year as a graduate analyst in a consultancy's risk practice.
propositions.rationale: The resume documents the grade, the years and the second reviewer role.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate performed the validation testing on those reviews under the bank's validation standard, drafted the findings sections and open items lists of the reports, kept the review boundary sections current, and attended the model risk committee with the reviewer of record for four reviews.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the test workbook document the testing, the drafting and the committee attendance.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been the senior reviewer of record on validation reviews and signed validation reports as senior reviewer.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the candidate at associate grade as second reviewer, with the reports signed by the reviewer of record and the committee presentations made with that reviewer; the senior-level claim comes from the screen and the LinkedIn title, and she confirmed she has not signed a report.

expectedGap: The materials document associate-grade work as second reviewer under the reviewer of record; they do not document the candidate as senior reviewer of record, signing reports or presenting to the committee in her own name.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the grade and the second reviewer role as the resume states them; the reviewer of record signed the reports.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the signed validation reports to confirm who was reviewer of record on each of the eleven reviews.
